source_row.extraction_instructions: The /events/ hub is an index of ~13 event-series pages, not a dated list. Each series page holds the current year's event as prose with the date in a sentence (ordinal days, weekday lists, often no year); some series have one level of sub-pages (IR Juniors -> NIRS/RiiSE, Webinars -> Upcoming webinars). The extractor crawls hub -> series -> sub-pages, takes the first non-deadline date line per page and fees from the page's Register link (BSIR page or the CIRSE meeting site).

registry_comment: BSIR (interventional radiology): crawl of /events/ series pages for the dated prose line; fees from the Register link (VITALS two-column page, ASM CIRSE grid)

spot_check.site_says: VITALS 2027 : Thursday 11th - Friday 12th March, Sopwell Hosue, St Albans
BSIR Member £450 early until 17 September, £510 regular

concerns: /events/ is an index of series pages, not a dated list: the extractor reads one prose date line per page (first line that is not a deadline/opening notice). A page that words its date unusually will be missed; unit-level logic is in events_from_page().
IOUK 2027 page says 'Thursday 10th and Friday 12th June' (the 12th is a Saturday): only 2027-06-10 is stored, end_date = start_date, deliberately not guessed.
VITALS venue is published as 'Sopwell Hosue' (typo for Sopwell House) and stored as published.

ASM 2026 city is Birmingham but the venue name is only on the CIRSE-built bsirmeeting.org venue page (not fetched); fees there are parsed from the public grid (Early / Regular). ASC 2027 and IOUK 2027 fees are 'open in the New Year', webinar and VASIG registrations are free MS Teams links: tiers [] justified.

VASIG-UK 2026 ends 2026-10-21 (today) and drops out tomorrow. NIRS26, RiiSE26, Basic Skills 2026, Paediatric IR 2026 and the Registrar Study Day are already past and are skipped by date; next year's pages will appear when the society edits them.
Members-only page 'BSIR 2026: what's in store' (Access Denied) is skipped; fees shown are public ones only.

Coverage checklist: multi-day ranges (end_date) checked against the page on every source; no fee-table images were seen on the tested pages; SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT warnings from the harness --coverage run were false positives (related-event lists / unrelated '4 days' wording on the same page).
remediator.audit not run (needs the database); harness --coverage was run instead.
Review fix: region is now the UK nation from a local city table (England / Scotland / Wales / Northern Ireland) instead of 'United Kingdom'; cities outside the table get no region.

Audit fix (IOUK abstract flag): abstract_open=True came from the merge-step classifier reading 'Abstracts and Case Studies will open in the New Year' as an open call. The extractor now supplies the status itself from the page's own sentences: future opening -> abstract_open False with a note (IOUK 2027), 'will open on <date>' with a date already passed -> True with no deadline and a note (VITALS 2027, opened 9 Oct). Provided only if the merge step lets the extractor value stand; if the merge re-derives it from page text the false positive can recur and needs a guard on 'will open' wording in abstract_classifier (shared file, not touched).
Also the h1-based crawl start now skips cookie/consent headings.
